يصطدمون (form VIII)
# يَصْطَدِمُونَ (yaṣṭadimūna) /jasˤ.tˤa.di.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# يُصْطَدَمُونَ (yuṣṭadamūna) /jusˤ.tˤa.da.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
